summary: The menu is unchanged in character: 50 names all scoring F7 or better, with every test computable (fscore_computable 9 everywhere), so no score is propped up by missing data. VRSN, CARG and FTDR combine top in-sector gross profitability with CFO above net income and F8-F9; the held quality names (CARG, IDXX, DPZ, MSM) all remain on the screen. The main accounting concerns are GRMN and ONC (amended filings flag, and GRMN's CFO below net income), DORM (CFO well under net income), stale fiscal years at CLX, TTEK, SMG, BLBD and SBH, and RRC and CART, whose screen metrics no longer matter because each is being acquired. No lesson in learning.json names the fundamentals-analyst; I applied L3's sector-label caveat (written for the proposer and PM) when flagging misfiled sectors, and it does not conflict with today's evidence.
